id: \rThank you so much for saving our Eggs. How would you like to take one as a gift?
en: \rThank you so much for saving our Eggs. How would you like to take one as a gift?
it: \rGrazie mille per aver salvato le nostre Uova. Che ne dici di prenderne una in regalo?

id: \rOh, you can't carry it with you.
en: \rOh, you can't carry it with you.

id: \rMake some space in your party and come back.
en: \rMake some space in your party and come back.
it: \rFai un po' di spazio nella tua squadra e poi torna.

id: \rJessie: With these Eggs we will make millions.
en: \rJessie: With these Eggs we will make millions.

id: \bMeowth: It's perfect. They can't even fight back. Who knows what kind of rare beauties are in there.
en: \bMeowth: It's perfect. They can't even fight back.  Who knows what kind of rare beauties are in there.
it: \bMeowth: È perfetto. Non possono neanche difendersi.  Chissà che rare bellezze ci sono lì dentro.

id: \bJames: Oh no. When did they get here?
en: \bJames: Oh no. When did they get here?

id: \bJames: Let's get out of here while we can.
en: \bJames: Let's get out of here while we can.

id: \rThank you so much for saving our Eggs. Let me heal you as thanks.
en: \rThank you so much for saving our Eggs. Let me heal you as thanks.
it: \rGrazie mille per aver salvato le nostre Uova. Lascia che curi i tuoi Pokémon per ringraziarti.

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!
